title: ZPA application segments
aliases: which application segment handles this request

prose.text: "Which application segment handles this request, and how is it configured?" splits into the questions below.

steps.label: Which segment is picked when several cover the destination?
steps.text: Granularity, port misses and carve-outs: [[zpa.app-segments.matching]], with the exact-match behavior itself in [[zpa.policy.multimatch]].

steps.label: Does the Bypass setting override that?
Can one request match more than one segment?
steps.text: Multimatch consistency and examples in [[zpa.app-segments.multimatch]], its prerequisites and restrictions in [[zpa.app-segments.multimatch-requirements]].

steps.label: What may a segment contain and which settings interact?
steps.text: Entries, ports and wildcards in [[zpa.app-segments.definition]]; health reporting, connector selection, CNAME, ICMP, encryption and anchoring in [[zpa.app-segments.settings]].

steps.label: How do health checks, Double Encryption and discovery work?
steps.text: Health Reporting modes and the check mechanism: [[zpa.app-segments.health-reporting]]. Double Encryption: [[zpa.app-segments.double-encryption]]. Application discovery and the 14-day widget: [[zpa.app-segments.discovery]]. DNS search domains: [[zpa.app-segments.dns-search-domains]].

steps.label: Can a segment hold patterns, or route by CNAME?
steps.text: Asterisk and question-mark patterns in FQDNs: [[zpa.app-segments.pattern-matching]]. Private link resources matched by returned CNAME: [[zpa.app-segments.private-link-domains]].

steps.label: How are segments created in bulk, recommended or labeled?
steps.text: AI-powered recommendations: [[zpa.app-segments.ai-recommendations]]. CSV import and merge: [[zpa.app-segments.import]]. Namespaces and tags: [[zpa.app-segments.tags]]. The Defined Application Segments page, with its delete and edit locks: [[zpa.app-segments.admin-console]].

steps.label: What do the API and SDK fields look like?
How are common enterprise applications set up?
steps.text: Unified communications, FTP, RDP, file servers, Citrix, Configuration Manager, SAP and others: [[zpa.app-segments.enterprise-apps]].

steps.label: Can a segment reach a user's device instead of a server?
steps.text: Client-to-client and server-to-client connectivity and the Zscaler IP ranges: [[zpa.peer-to-peer]].

steps.label: Which tool defects change what is sent?

prose.text: Every segment belongs to a segment group: [[zpa.segment-groups]]. After the segment is chosen, access policy decides whether the request is allowed: [[zpa.policy.evaluation-order]].
